== Summary ==
Change crop (after) for [[Twilight Is Upon Me (V)|Twilight Is Upon Me (V) (Errata)]]: the region (108, 740, 716, 1036) (x0, y0, x1, y1 in pixels) cut unchanged, without resizing, from the Players Committee card image of [[Twilight Is Upon Me (V)|Twilight Is Upon Me (V) (Errata)]] (PC-E1): [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/efc26cd8f4f02c4acb5707cb0d67361cc69322ba/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual22-Light/large/twilightisuponme.gif Holotable commit efc26cd] (2024-12-29). The matching before crop is [[:File:V22-L-twilightisuponme-2024-12-29-change-crop-before.png]]. Compared with the image of [[Twilight Is Upon Me (V)]] ([https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/2494181434fdfa411310a5b0e0d0aa18ef8b64de/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual22-Light/large/twilightisuponme.gif commit 2494181]) and [[Twilight Is Upon Me (V)|Twilight Is Upon Me (V) (Errata)]] ([https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/efc26cd8f4f02c4acb5707cb0d67361cc69322ba/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual22-Light/large/twilightisuponme.gif commit efc26cd]).
